subject: {first_name}, your {streak}-day streak breaks in a few hours
preview_text: One chart scan keeps it alive.
body_paragraphs: You're on a {streak}-day analysis streak. That's rare — most people open a trading app once and disappear.
If you don't scan a chart before midnight, the streak resets. One upload is enough.
Open Command, scan the pair you actually care about, and keep the chain going.
P.S. Streaks aren't about grinding — they're about becoming the kind of trader who shows up with a process.
